Dynamatic Technologies was incorporated in 1973 as a manufacturer of [[hydraulic pump]]s. In the 1990s, it expanded to aerospace grade components and aircraft assemblies. In the early 2000s, the company tied up with [[Hindustan Aeronautics Limited]] (HAL) and was involved in fabrication and assembly of HAL's [[subsonic aircraft|subsonic]] intermediate training jets. It started making body parts for the [[Sukhoi Su-30MKI]] and the [[DRDO Lakshya|Lakshya]] jets. It then began supplying flap track beams to [[Airbus]] for its [[Airbus A320 family|A320 family]] of aircraft and the wide-body [[Airbus A330|330 aircraft]].{{cite news |last1=Sanjai |first1=P. Suvarna Raju in the presence of the Minister of State for Defence, Dr. Subhash Ramrao Bhamre.jpg|CEO Udayant Malhoutra handing over the 100th set of Su-30MKI assemblies to HAL File:Prime Minister Theresa May visits Dynamatic Technologies in Bangalore.jpg|UK Prime Minister [[Theresa May]] during her visit to Dynamatic's manufacturing unit at Bangalore ==Acquisitions== *In 2008, Dynamatic acquired the British aerospace parts manufacturing company Oldland CNC for {{USD}}16 million.{{cite news |title=Dynamatic Technologies Ltd |url=https://www1.nseindia.com/education/content/reports/Dynamatictech_base.pdf |access-date=13 August 2021 |work=NSE}} *In 2011, Dynamatic acquired German automotive component manufacturer Eisenwerke Erla GmbH.{{cite news |last1=Abrar |first1=Peerzada |last2=Nair |first2=Radhika P. |title=Dynamatic Technologies buys German auto component maker Eisenwerke Erla |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/engineering/dynamatic-technologies-buys-german-auto-component-maker-eisenwerke-erla/articleshow/8703953.cms |access-date=13 August 2021 |work=The Economic Times}} ==See also== * [[Automotive industry in India]] ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Defence companies of India]] [[Category:Engineering companies of India]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Bengaluru]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
extract: Dynamatic Technologies is an Indian precision engineering company, based in Bangalore. The company is a global supplier of parts to aerospace, automotive, hydraulic and security assemblers. Udayant Malhoutra is the CEO & Managing Director of the company.
